captions_note: the label repeats the speaker's words: hide the reel captions just for the words the label shows (--hide-captions a-b), or build with CAPTIONS=0 for the number alone
in_a_reel: set GRADE = 'none' in the CLIP block (the reel owns the look)
set OUT about 0.25 s before the slot ends, unless the slot ends on a cut or at the end of the reel
steps: run measure.py      # words with measured start / end, where the speaker's head is
edit the CLIP block in build.py
run build.py SAFE=1      # prints lock frame, panel position, label times, warnings (!!)
hf snapshot --at 0.2,1.0,2.0      # use: roll, lock+0.1, lock+0.6, last 0.1 s
run check.py      # frame count, text-behind-the speaker test, tick timing, sheet, stills, phone copy
